lines.t: A silent longing fills the air
Hearts are trembling, souls laid bare
On this day, the book is open wide
We enter in where mercy abides
The veil is lifted, shadows fall away
In sacred awe we kneel and pray
High Priest above in the true holy place
Your sacrifice is endless grace
Not with the blood of goats or sheep
But with Your own
The promise You keep
Once for all the atonement made
Ancient fear and death now fade
Let the trumpet sound
Let broken hearts return
Redemption flows, a river pours
From pierced hands where mercy burns
Remembered each year with sorrow and fast
Yet finished forever, completed at last
The Lamb went in where none had gone
High Priest and Sacrifice all in one
In this holy shadow we see the light
The judge is mercy, the wrong made right
Remember, reflect, restore this day
The King has opened the living way
Let my life be an offering
Pure and true
No words of men
No customs accrue
Only surrender
In spirit and truth
Resting in love renewed
Let the trumpet sound
Let broken hearts return
Redemption flows, a river pours
From His hands where mercy burns
Oh, my God.
